edges.derivation: T1-03 produces calibrated field state posterior estimates (RZSM, crop water status); T2-01 implements uncertainty-aware AquaCrop calibration which requires these field state outputs as driving inputs for crop model parameter inference. Source: Source B cross-WP task analysis.

T3-02 assesses uncertainty calibration quality of the diagnostic branch against the RQ5 90% prediction interval target; it requires the posterior estimates produced by T1-03 to evaluate calibration. Source: Source B cross-WP task analysis.

T3-03 runs the co-located patch-covariation campaign to validate the Route B homogeneous-patch proxy assumption implemented in T1-02; Route B must exist and produce outputs before the campaign can validate it. Source: Source B cross-WP task analysis.

dependency_analysis_notes.source_a_wp_edges: All five work_packages[].dependencies[] arrays are empty in the input artifact (normalization note: 'No dependency arrays present in seed; all WP dependencies set to empty arrays. WP-level dependency edges omitted from dependency_map. Dependency enrichment delegated to wp-dependency-analysis skill.'). Source A contributed 0 WP-level edges.
dependency_analysis_notes.source_b_cross_wp_task_edges: Three cross-WP task edges identified by structural analysis of task titles and WP objectives within the declared input artifact: (1) T1-03→T2-01 (field state posterior consumed by AquaCrop calibration); (2) T1-03→T3-02 (diagnostic branch output assessed for calibration quality); (3) T1-02→T3-03 (Route B implementation validated by patch-covariation campaign).
dependency_analysis_notes.cycle_detection_method: Kahn's topological sort algorithm applied over 18-node, 3-edge directed graph. In-degrees at start: T2-01=1, T3-02=1, T3-03=1; all others=0. All 18 nodes processed to completion; no nodes remained with in-degree>0 after queue exhaustion. No cycles detected.
dependency_analysis_notes.critical_path_method: Longest-path dynamic programming over topological order. Edge weight=1. Maximum path length=1 edge (2 nodes). Three equal-length candidate paths: T1-03→T2-01, T1-03→T3-02, T1-02→T3-03. Critical path reported as T1-03→T2-01 (primary scientific dependency chain: probabilistic diagnostic branch → uncertainty-aware decision engine calibration). All critical_path_nodes verified present in dependency_map.nodes.
dependency_analysis_notes.wp_level_structural_note: WP-level structural dependencies (WP2 depends on WP1 outputs; WP3 validates WP1 outputs) are represented via task-level cross-WP edges per Source B rather than as WP-node edges, because no WP-level dependency declarations exist in the seed's dependencies[] arrays and the task-level edges carry the actual data-flow semantics.
